Package frc.DELib25.Interpolation

Class InterpolatingTreeMap<K extends InverseInterpolable<K> & Comparable<K>,V extends edu.wpi.first.math.interpolation.Interpolatable<V>>

java.lang.Object
java.util.AbstractMap<K,V>
java.util.TreeMap<K,V>
frc.DELib25.Interpolation.InterpolatingTreeMap<K,V>
Type Parameters:
K - The type of the key (must implement InverseInterpolable)
V - The type of the value (must implement Interpolable)
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Cloneable, Map<K,V>, NavigableMap<K,V>, SequencedMap<K,V>, SortedMap<K,V>
public class InterpolatingTreeMap<K extends InverseInterpolable<K> & Comparable<K>,V extends edu.wpi.first.math.interpolation.Interpolatable<V>> extends TreeMap<K,V>
Interpolating Tree Maps are used to get values at points that are not defined by making a guess from points that are defined. This uses linear interpolation.

    • getInterpolated

      public V getInterpolated(K key)
      Retrieves an interpolated value for the given key.
      Parameters:
      key - The key to look up a value for. The key does not need to exist in the map.
      Returns:
      The interpolated value if the key is between existing bounds, the nearest value if the key is out of bounds, or null if the map is empty.
